prompt:
A cinematic storyboard sheet for a Sri Lankan television drama: 9 photorealistic film stills of ONE scene, laid out in a grid 3 panels across and 3 down, read left to right, then top to bottom. Every panel is a tall portrait 9:16 still of the same size, separated by thin, even, plain white gutters. All panels are the same moment's world, painted together: the same people, props, weather, light and colour grade in every panel.

Reference images, in order: image 1 is the location plate for Colombo roadside; image 2 is the reference sheet for phone. Take from image 1: the kind of place: its ground, water, plants, structures and materials. It is ONE view of the place; each panel has its own camera position, so do not repeat this view in every panel; image 2: phone exactly as shown.

People (every panel): every person is a smooth, matte, faceless artist's mannequin in one solid colour, with jointed limbs and simple hands: Kasun is the red mannequin; Anudi is the blue mannequin. A small raised ridge on the front of the head, where a nose would be, shows which way the head faces. Each mannequin has the person's real height and build and sits, stands and holds things exactly as a real person would. No faces, no hair, no clothes, no skin: only the mannequin colour. Everything else (the place, the props, the light, the weather) is a real, photorealistic film still.

World (every panel): One painted storyboard image, four columns by three rows, with ten panels in shot order across the rows; leave the final two grid positions empty. Use clean gutters without lettering, numbers, captions or arrows. Kasun is a smooth red artist's mannequin and Anudi a smooth blue artist's mannequin, retaining their reference heights and builds; describe and paint their performances through pose alone. Paint the setting and props realistically: rain-wet asphalt, concrete pavement, an open kerb drain, weathered commercial buildings and a modest food three-wheeler with a dark canopy, metal serving ledge and covered food trays. Soft early-morning, rain-filtered daylight comes from the open road at camera right, with subdued amber shop practicals behind the vending bay. Maintain warm natural light, muted grey, beige and green surroundings, and controlled wet reflections throughout. Anudi's orange smartphone has a transparent case and the reference camera cluster. Her left hand holds the open navy umbrella throughout, and the tan structured handbag hangs from her left forearm. Kasun's hands are empty after the opening handover. Nothing on the phone or elsewhere contains readable writing.

Geography: The conversation takes place on a narrow pavement between the road and a compact vending bay. The food three-wheeler stands at the left end, backed by a muted green frontage beneath a weathered concrete balcony; Kasun stands just to its right, with Anudi farther right. Beyond Anudi, the pavement continues screen right beside a pale stained boundary wall and a concrete utility pole. The kerb drain follows this entire route along its roadward edge. All cameras stay on the roadward side of the Kasun–Anudi axis: Kasun remains screen left facing right, Anudi screen right facing left. Her eventual departure follows the pavement across frame toward screen right, while his return is toward the three-wheeler at screen left. This board ends on the standing opening of that departure shot, before either person changes position.

PANEL 1 (row 1, column 1) — Standing eye height on the roadward side, looking across the pavement toward the vending bay; 50mm waist-up two-shot with both pairs of hands included. Background: The food three-wheeler and its dark canopy sit behind Kasun at frame left. The pale boundary wall and the beginning of the open pavement route occupy frame right. The red mannequin stands left with its chest and head directed right toward the blue mannequin, extending the orange smartphone in its right hand between them; its left hand hangs down. The blue mannequin stands right with its chest and head directed left, its open right hand immediately beneath the offered handset, without yet taking its weight. Its left hand grips the umbrella shaft beside its shoulder, with the tan handbag suspended from that forearm; the canopy spans the upper right of the frame.
PANEL 2 (row 1, column 2) — Standing eye height from the roadward master position, looking toward the vending bay; 35mm medium-wide framing to mid-thigh, with the business clearly included. Background: The three-wheeler, serving ledge and covered trays occupy the left background beneath the green frontage. The pale wall and open route continue right, with the kerb drain along the lower roadward edge. The red mannequin stands screen left, chest and head turned right toward the blue mannequin, with both empty hands lowered. The blue mannequin stands screen right with its chest facing left and its head directed toward the red mannequin, holding the smartphone low in its right hand at waist level. Its left hand supports the open umbrella, and the handbag remains on its left forearm.
PANEL 3 (row 1, column 3) — Standing eye height at the same roadward position as shot 1; 50mm waist-up two-shot, with the two mannequins at equal scale. Background: The softly resolved food canopy and serving bay remain frame left behind Kasun. The pale wall remains frame right behind Anudi. The red mannequin stands left with its chest and head directed right toward the blue mannequin, both empty hands resting down beside its body. The blue mannequin stands right, chest and head directed left toward its partner, with the smartphone held low in its right hand between them. Its left hand stays around the umbrella shaft, with the handbag hanging from the same forearm.
PANEL 4 (row 2, column 1) — Standing eye height on the roadward side, angled toward Kasun without crossing the axis; 75mm chest-up medium close-up, with space to screen right. Background: The food canopy forms soft dark shapes at frame left, with a muted green patch of the vending frontage below it. The far concrete frontage softens toward frame right. The red mannequin fills the left-centre of the panel in three-quarter profile, its chest facing right toward the blue mannequin outside the frame. Its head follows the same rightward direction with a level tilt, rather than turning toward the camera. Both empty hands remain lowered below the crop.
PANEL 5 (row 2, column 2) — Standing eye height on the roadward side, looking toward Anudi; 50mm waist-up medium shot with her right hand and smartphone inside the lower frame. Background: A narrow, softly resolved edge of the vending canopy stays at far frame left. The pale stained boundary wall occupies the centre and right background, with the utility pole near the right edge. The blue mannequin stands right of centre in three-quarter profile, its chest and head directed left toward the red mannequin outside the frame. Its right hand holds the smartphone at its right hip, with no incoming-call display presented to the camera. Its left hand holds the open umbrella shaft upright, and the tan handbag rests against the left forearm.
PANEL 6 (row 2, column 3) — Slightly above standing head height, looking obliquely down from the roadward side; 50mm chest-up medium close-up, keeping the head and upright handset clear together. Background: The vending canopy remains a narrow fragment at far frame left. The pale boundary wall lies behind Anudi at frame right, with a small area of wet pavement visible beneath the handset. The blue mannequin's chest remains directed left, while its head tilts down toward the upright smartphone in its right hand just below its head. The handset is angled between the mannequin and camera so the incoming-call layout is visible, using simple interface shapes without lettering or a portrait. Its left hand holds the umbrella shaft beside its shoulder, with the handbag remaining on the forearm below the crop.
PANEL 7 (row 3, column 1) — Standing head height from the roadward side, maintaining Anudi's leftward orientation; 85mm close-up of her head, raised right hand and handset. Background: The pale wall becomes soft beige-grey shapes across the right background. A dark sliver of the same vending canopy remains at the far left edge. The blue mannequin's head fills most of the panel in three-quarter profile directed screen left, with its chest also oriented left beneath the tight crop. Its raised right hand holds the orange smartphone against the right side of its head. The left hand continues holding the umbrella below the crop, with a short section of the shaft visible near the shoulder.
PANEL 8 (row 3, column 2) — Standing eye height at the same roadward position as shots 1 and 3; 50mm waist-up two-shot with the handset included. Background: The three-wheeler and canopy remain behind Kasun at frame left. The pale wall and open pavement route remain behind Anudi at frame right. The red mannequin stands left, chest and head directed right toward the blue mannequin, with both empty hands lowered. The blue mannequin stands right with its chest facing left, its head held slightly downward-left, and its right hand keeping the smartphone against the right side of its head. Its left hand supports the open umbrella while the tan handbag hangs from its left forearm.
PANEL 9 (row 3, column 3) — Standing eye height at the established roadward two-shot position; 50mm waist-up framing, with Anudi's lowered handset visible. Background: The food canopy and softly resolved serving bay remain frame left. The pale boundary wall and the clear pavement route remain frame right. The blue mannequin stands screen right with its chest and head directed left toward the red mannequin, holding the smartphone low at its waist in its right hand. Its left hand grips the umbrella shaft, with the handbag supported by the left forearm. The red mannequin stands screen left facing right toward its partner, both empty hands hanging at its sides.

Bodies (every panel): each person sits or stands the way a real person does the task in front of them, never posed for the camera. The body faces the task and only the head turns: someone at a steering wheel sits squarely behind it, the wheel centred in front of the chest, back against the seat, both hands on the rim; someone at a desk sits square to it; someone at a stove faces the stove. A camera beside a person sees the body side-on, not the chest. Nobody looks into or faces the lens unless the panel says so. Head and eyes turn together: the eyes never roll hard to one side while the face points at the camera; a near-frontal face looks just past the lens.

Draw NO text of any kind: no panel numbers, no captions, no titles, no timestamps, no arrows, no labels, no borders other than the gutters. The people, place and everyday details are Sri Lankan.
